_meta.description: [Recruitment] 04 — Comms Routing: Receives CRM-routed candidate payload from Batch 4. Pre-builds all outbound communication content (email subjects/bodies, Slack card color) in one Code node pass using client templates from Postgres with word-char interpolation. Sends Slack ops alert for every candidate. IF gate on composite score ≥ threshold: QUALIFIED path sends acceptance Gmail + creates ClickUp follow-up task; REJECTED path sends rejection Gmail only. Dual-terminal pattern (QUALIFIED/REJECTED Code nodes) ensures exactly 1 item returned to sub-workflow caller regardless of branch taken.

placeholders: [SLACK_CREDENTIAL_ID] — replace with your n8n slackApi credential ID (Slack OAuth2)
[SLACK_OPS_CHANNEL_ID] — replace with your Slack ops channel ID (e.g. C0123456789). Find via: Slack → right-click channel → Copy link → last segment
[GMAIL_CREDENTIAL_ID] — replace with your n8n gmailOAuth2 credential ID. Used for both accepted and rejected emails
[CLICKUP_CREDENTIAL_ID] — replace with your n8n clickUpApi credential ID
[CLICKUP_TEAM_ID] — replace with your ClickUp workspace ID. Find via: ClickUp → Settings → Workspace → ID
[CLICKUP_SPACE_ID] — replace with your ClickUp space ID. Find via ClickUp URL: /space/{id}
[CLICKUP_FOLDER_ID] — replace with your ClickUp folder ID, or 'no_folder' if list is folderless. Find via ClickUp URL: /folder/{id}
[CLICKUP_LIST_ID] — replace with your ClickUp list ID for recruitment follow-ups. Find via ClickUp URL: /list/{id}
